title: Spot Scams Before They Spot You
summary: Learn the tricks behind fake alerts, OTP calls and too-good offers, and what to do if you are targeted. Short and interactive.

overview.about: Scams reach people by phone, text, social media and in person, and they work by rushing you. This course shows the tricks scammers use, how to spot them in a few seconds, and what to do if one reaches you.
youWillLearn: The pressure tricks scammers rely on: urgency, fear, greed and false trust
How fake alerts, OTP calls and phishing links work, and how to check them
The warning signs of fake investments, loan offers and job ads
What to do straight away if you have been targeted

recap: Scammers win by rushing you, so your best defence is to slow down and check.
Never share an OTP, PIN or password, and confirm any alert in your own bank app.
An offer that asks you to pay first, or promises easy money, is a warning sign.
If it happens, act fast: tell your bank, keep the evidence and report it.
actionPoints: Today, tell one family member or friend about the scam trick that surprised you most.
Agree a family code word you can use to confirm a money request.
Save your bank's customer care number in your phone, taken from your card or its official app.
finish.nextSteps: Come back to this course whenever a message makes you nervous. A two-minute refresher is cheaper than a mistake. Then learn to use AI tools well, which includes how to check answers that only sound sure.
